dedupe_keys.name: dublin city development plan 2022 2028 zoning and conservation layers

description: Dublin City Council publishes geospatial layers of the Dublin City Development Plan 2022-2028: land-use zoning, architectural conservation areas, strategic development zones, strategic development and regeneration areas, conservation areas and local area plans. Coverage: Dublin City, Ireland, for the plan period 2022 to 2028; layers in Irish Transverse Mercator projection, last modified on 2025-11-13. Format and access: ZIP, GEOJSON, WMS, downloadable without registration from the Smart Dublin open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: the provider warns that the layers might not be up to date and that variations to the plan are listed on its website; each zoning class is a separate resource. Simulation uses: land-use and zoning constraints on future building capacity, and protected-area overlays in urban growth and flood-adaptation scenarios. Related catalogue records: Dublin Fire Brigade stations (Dublin region) (data-dublin-fire-brigade-stations).
